choose.title: How will this phone use Tula?
choose.anywhereHelp: Bill anywhere, even with no internet and the shop computer switched off. Bills and changes go to the cloud copy whenever there is internet.
choose.computerHelp: Open Tula from the shop computer over the shop Wi-Fi. Works only in the shop, while that computer is on.

setup.title: Set up this phone
setup.lead: This phone copies the business from the cloud copy once. Only this step needs internet.
setup.urlHint: Starts with libsql://. It is TULA_SYNC_URL in the shop computer's settings file, or shown in Turso.
setup.tokenHint: The same token as the shop computer (TULA_SYNC_TOKEN). It is a password: paste it here only, never on WhatsApp.
setup.name: Name for this phone
setup.start: Copy the business to this phone
setup.required: Fill in the cloud address and the access token.

errors.OFFLINE: No internet. Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
errors.AUTH: The cloud refused the access token. Check it and try again.
errors.BAD_URL: The cloud address is not correct. It looks like libsql://name-yourname.turso.io
errors.EMPTY_HUB: The cloud copy is empty. Turn on the cloud copy on the shop computer first, then set up this phone.
errors.OTHER: This phone could not be set up: {{detail}}
errors.noStorage: This phone cannot store Tula's data. Update "Android System WebView" from the Play Store, then open Tula again.

phoneLead.ok: Every bill and change on this phone is also in the cloud copy, so the shop computer has it too.
phoneLead.starting: The first copy will be sent in a few seconds.
phoneLead.problem: Billing still works on this phone. Changes wait here and are sent when there is internet.

phoneErrors.OFFLINE: No internet on this phone. Billing keeps working; changes are sent when the internet is back.
phoneErrors.AUTH: The cloud refused the access token. If it was changed on the shop computer, enter the new one below.
phoneErrors.BAD_URL: The cloud address is not correct. Enter it again below.
phoneErrors.REVOKED: This phone was marked as lost, so it no longer sends or receives data.

thisPhone.title: This phone
thisPhone.series: This phone's bills are numbered in series {{series}}.
thisPhone.tokenHelp: Do this after a new token was made in Turso (for example when a phone was lost). Tula restarts afterwards.
thisPhone.shopComputerHelp: Opens Tula from the shop computer over the shop Wi-Fi. This phone's data stays here; you can come back to it from the connect screen.
thisPhone.pending: {{count}} change(s) on this phone are not in the cloud copy yet. Connect to the internet and tap Sync now first.
